plansList.title: Publishing
plansList.noPlansHint: Create a plan to export your project as EPUB, PDF, HTML, or Markdown.
plansList.deleteDialogMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
plansList.subtitle: Assemble documents into an EPUB, PDF, website, or Markdown export.

planEditor.noItemsHint: Use "Add documents" to pick what to publish, drag folders and documents from the project tree, or add everything
planEditor.addEverythingHint: Adds every prose document and worldbuilding entry, including the README. Notes are skipped.
planEditor.alreadyIncluded: “{{name}}” is already included in this plan
planEditor.includeTocHint: Untick to hide the Table of contents item in Contents without removing it. Reader navigation is unaffected.
planEditor.includeCoverHint: The cover image only. For a title page with the title and author, add Frontmatter > Title Page in Contents.
planEditor.chapterHeadingHint: EPUB and HTML only (PDF and Markdown are unchanged). Adds a heading above any document that doesn't already start with one.
planEditor.typographicQuotesHint: Curls straight quotes and apostrophes and turns -- into a dash for the book's language. Your documents are not changed. On by default except for Markdown.
planEditor.coverImageHint: Leave blank to use the project cover image
planEditor.generateHint: Add at least one document to generate the publication
planEditor.noPublishedHint: Generate to create the first version
planEditor.addDocumentsSubtitle: Choose folders, documents and worldbuilding entries to include in this publication

stats.pagesHint: Estimated at 275 words per printed page
stats.readingHint: Estimated reading time at 238 words per minute
stats.unavailableHint: Some documents have not been downloaded to this device yet. They will be fetched when you publish.
stats.wordsHint: Words in the plan's documents. The title page, table of contents and worldbuilding entries are not included, so the Preview tab total can be slightly higher.

preview.wordsHint: Words in the rendered output: the documents plus the title page, table of contents and any other items in the plan. Styles and markup are not counted.
preview.emptyState: Generate a preview of your publication
preview.noteEpub: EPUB readers apply their own fonts and page sizes; this preview shows the content as a single flowing page.
preview.noteSite: The website export produces one page per chapter. This preview shows the same content as a single page.

styleEditor.reflowableNote: E-books reflow to each reader's screen, so page size, margins and page numbers are left to the reading device.
styleEditor.printPresetInEbook: This is a print preset. Its page setup is ignored in an EPUB; pick an e-book preset to tune the text for e-readers.

complete.title: Published Successfully!
complete.uploadFailed: The file was generated and saved on this device, but uploading it to the server failed ({{reason}}). It isn't published or shareable yet.
complete.quotaRefused: Your sync capacity is full, so this file was saved on this device only and can't be shared yet. Free up space and publish again to share it.
